Q1: While `HEAL_INTAKE_SCOPE_GUARD_ENABLED` is off (the default), what should the heal intake do just before `gh issue create`?
Choices:
A: Create no heal issue at all, whether or not a scope marker is present, and log a stable skip line. This stops all heal issue filing by default until an operator turns the flag on.
B: Create the issue only when a well-formed `ai:workflow-heal-scope:v1` marker was produced. If the marker is missing or invalid, skip creation with a stable warning log line, no CRITICAL alert and exit 0. The CRITICAL alert and nonzero exit apply only when the flag is on. (RECOMMENDED)
C: Keep today's behaviour exactly: create the issue even with an unresolved marker, and rely on the existing implement-side `HEAL_SCOPE_REFUSED` preflight to fail closed later. The flag only enables the new pre-creation refusal.
